approved_by.evidence: Explicit request to implement the next BH-03 phase section by section, merge one pull request, synchronize main, and delete the feature branch.

authorized_scope: Implement idempotent registry-owned shutdown with bounded root quiescence, runtime acknowledgement, and unconditional transport release.
Reject new roots after shutdown begins and preserve root/runtime ownership boundaries.
Accept runtime-loss reports only for the exact active scope generation and reject stale reports without mutation.
Attempt at most one governed replacement after a retryable post-readiness runtime loss.
Replay existing registered, ready, and disposed roots through their existing handles and reject partial recovery.
Return bounded non-DOM fallback decisions for mismatch, unsupported prerequisites, non-retryable loss, or recovery exhaustion.
Publish versioned Phase 5 fixtures, validation, and completion evidence.
not_authorized: more than one runtime replacement, unbounded retry, or restart loops
DOM, HTML, or browser-profile fallback rendering
active browser composition or browser result claims
renderer, component, Phoenix, Plug, LiveView, or server command behavior
resource or reliability measurements and BH-03 acceptance
public API stability, package publication, or support claims
